text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the fiercely 
contested Queen Elizabeth II Cup is ME! 
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, the way everyone looks at me remains 
unchanged. There are still those who 
refuse to acknowledge me as their 
'Princess.'”

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I shall keep 
running! To continue showing the 
princeliness I take pride in, I'll deliver 
a Princess☆Punch straight toward the 
future!"
